sloka: ततस्तैरेव रक्षांसि दुर्धरैः प्रवरायुधैः ।भित्त्वा विद्रावयामास वायुरम्बुधरानिव ।। ७.३२.७१ ॥
transliteration: tatastaireva rakṣāṁsi durdharaiḥ pravarāyudhaiḥ ।bhittvā vidrāvayāmāsa vāyurambudharāniva ।। 7.32.71 ॥

translations.english: Then, with those very formidable and excellent weapons, Arjuna pierced and dispersed the Rakshasas, just as the wind scatters clouds.
